purpose: Structured, mechanically-discoverable registry of 'GOVERNANCE FLAG'-style callouts raised inline in claims.yaml prose (what_would_answer / evidence_quality_note / digestion_note) or in WORKSPACE_STATE.md Recent Work, most often by /thought-digestion sessions honouring the standing rule 'flag for /governance review, do not promote or resolve yourself mid-digestion'. Before this file existed, such flags were discoverable only by a human or agent noticing distinctive wording while reading a long, ever-growing WORKSPACE_STATE.md during /governance's own Session Startup Protocol orientation step -- which works only if the flag is recent enough to still be near the top. Confirmed staleness this caused: the ARC-033 promotion flag (GFLAG-0001, raised 2026-08-06) was still unactioned a full day later; the SD-014 discrepancy flag (GFLAG-0003, raised 2026-08-06) had already been resolved by an experiment run on 2026-08-04 that a LATER session had to independently re-discover from scratch because nothing pointed it at the open flag.
authority: This file is a derive-only, human/agent-adjudicated INPUT, exactly like sibling evidence/planning/*.v1.json files (see hypothesis_space_registry.v1.json's own authority note for the pattern). It never mutates claims.yaml, closure weights, or claim status by itself -- raising or resolving a flag here is bookkeeping, not a governance decision. /governance's own interactive review (see .claude/skills/governance/SKILL.md) is where a flag's substance actually gets acted on; this registry only guarantees the flag surfaces there instead of depending on luck.

flag_type_notes.promotion_review: A claim's status looks ready to move (e.g. candidate -> provisional/stable) but the flagging session deliberately did not promote it -- promotion is /governance's call, not a digestion-pass call.
flag_type_notes.evidence_discrepancy: A numeric, terminological, or structural mismatch was noticed (e.g. a claim describing N components when the substrate or a sibling claim implies a different N) that needs reconciliation, not just a note.
flag_type_notes.stale_note: A prose note (evidence_quality_note, live_status pointer, etc.) is suspected or confirmed to be pointing at outdated evidence and needs a governance-reviewed refresh.
flag_type_notes.contested_disposition: Two sessions, or a session and the user, reached different conclusions about how a claim should be classified or routed, and the disagreement was not resolved inline.

items.summary: thought-digestion flagged a 4-vs-6 valence-vector discrepancy on SD-014 (hippocampal map nodes storing a 4-component valence vector [wanting, liking, harm-discriminative, surprise] vs. a proposed 6-component amendment adding VALENCE_EXCITEMENT/VALENCE_DREAD channels) for /failure-autopsy + /governance to reconcile, deliberately excluding SD-014 from that digestion pass's what_would_answer batch rather than resolving the discrepancy inline.
items.resolution_note: Already resolved by executed evidence before the flag was reconciled, and independently re-discovered rather than looked up -- the concrete gap this registry exists to close. V3-EXQ-887 (2026-08-04) ran a dedicated, instrument-validated test of SD-014's core 4-component representational claim (C1 functional drive-gating, C2 representational separability, C3 replay-set selectivity), with the V3-EXQ-432 surprise-write pipeline gap confirmed fixed as a readiness precondition. Result: FAIL/weakens, confirmed non-degenerate by failure_autopsy_2026-08-05_pending_review_batch.md (#3): C1 (tau<=0.85) and C2 (Spearman<=0.90) fail on all 3 seeds (tau 0.867-0.889; Spearman 0.93-0.97); C3 passes. Root cause: VALENCE_WANTING and VALENCE_LIKING are both derived from the same underlying benefit_exposure signal via different transforms, not the independent dopamine/opioid pathways the cited biology (Berridge & Robinson 1998; Smith/Berridge/Aldridge 2011) requires. Hypothesis H-wanting-liking-separable-drive-gated registered eliminated in hypothesis_space_registry.v1.json. This directly eliminates the SD-014 4-component claim as specified, which supersedes rather than answers the original 4-vs-6-channel question (MECH-307 anticipatory_affect_conjunction vs. the proposed 6-channel SD-014 amendment): the amendment question is moot until the underlying 4-component wanting/liking dissociation is itself fixed. Autopsy-confirmed routing (user-confirmed, not yet ratified by /governance or chipped as of 2026-08-07): accept weakens, decouple VALENCE_WANTING's write-path via /implement-substrate. Full account in SD-014's own digestion_note in claims.yaml (session cool-torvalds-a82359, REE_assembly commit f33a36411d).

items.summary: The confirmed 2026-08-05 autopsy (V3-EXQ-867b section 2) records the screen-soundness violation as 'direct evidence the ON-arm manipulation itself perturbs whether/when decomposition fires', and that inference is carried verbatim into claims.yaml MECH-321 evidence_quality_note + what_would_answer and into hypothesis_space_registry observation_bottleneck + resolution.basis; 867b's own manifest contradicts it -- the violation appears in the OFF arm where the manipulation is provably inert (decomp_n_harm_bias_nonzero == 0 on every OFF cell), OFF-arm multi_action_commits DECREASED from the 4-episode screen to the 12-episode measurement on 5 seeds (impossible for a monotone counter over a prefix extension), and at full schedule the matching held perfectly (on_only and off_only tiers both EMPTY). Actual cause is an instrumentation defect: screen cells call _run_cell directly with no RNG reset while measurement cells enter through arm_cell (which calls reset_all_rng), so the two phases measure different agents and the prefix-monotonicity premise never applied. The ratified routing (redesign the DV) is UNAFFECTED and is now designed -- see evidence/planning/mech321_harm_aware_selection_measurement_redesign_staged_2026-08-08.md sections 2 and 8; only the recorded rationale needs correcting, which is a governance disposition not a chip's to make.

Ratified routing (redesign the DV away from post-hoc divergence-tick matching) is UNCHANGED. hypothesis_space_registry.v1.json's resolution.basis/observation_bottleneck still need syncing from the already-correct live_gate field -- that is /failure-autopsy Step 9b's job (single producer of that ledger), not governance's; chipped separately (chip-20260809-mech321-registry-sync). items.resolution_note: DECIDED (governance cycle 2026-08-16, cranky-driscoll-126a36): ADOPT PER-PAPER DEDUPLICATION INSIDE THE INDEXER, as the audit itself argues, rather than editing 48 duplicate groups pairwise. items.summary: V3-EXQ-436f (queued per confirmed failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-436e_2026-08-13) arms SD-016 cue-conditioning to fix 436e's P0 occupancy collapse, but a mechanistic caveat should be weighed when interpreting its result: 436e's collapse is on the WRITE path (ContextMemory.write addresses by argmin over query_proj on the 64-dim [z_self,z_world] state), while SD-016's cue_slot_tagger + ctxdiv loss act on the READ path (extract_cue_context, on 32-dim z_world via a separate tagger MLP trained on DETACHED z_world batches, 922's recipe) -- disjoint projections. So arming read-path selection is NOT mechanically guaranteed to lift write-slot occupancy, and 436f may reproduce 436e's insufficient_occupancy_for_c1 P0 failure. 436f's design discriminates this: its new 6th P0 gate sd016_arming_engaged=MET together with sufficient_occupancy_for_c1=UNMET is direct evidence the read-path fix does not reach write-path occupancy -> route the lineage to a WRITE-path successor (query_proj / z_world-entropy, e.g. the SD-070 encoder recipe that lifts z_world cross-context cosine) rather than another read-path letter. No action needed pre-run; this is context for governance when 436f completes.

items.summary: V3-EXQ-784 (SD-074 probe_warmup de-saturation sweep, PASS 2026-07-18) rests on a premise its own manifest states and that is FALSE: sd074_note asserts 'measure_action_mass is non-destructive ... so reading at one checkpoint leaves the agent bit-identical for continued training'. Measured on ree-cloud-5 2026-08-15: a probe read leaves 21 non-state_dict attributes changed, 17 of which survive agent.reset(); the load-bearing ones are agent._self/_world_experience_buffer, which warmup_train samples via agent.compute_prediction_loss(), so eval-rollout data enters the E1 training pool (buffers cap at 1000 and 784's reads are 1081-1401 env steps, i.e. full displacement). A controlled 2-seed replication of 784's ladder at its real config (budget-0 control cells bit-identical, as required) shows all six post-first-read cells differing by 0.011-0.146 on D_action_mass and TWO OF SIX flipping the saturation regime -- which is exactly the classification 784's informative_yield headline counts. Treat 784's informative_yield / target_met as provisional; full write-up and recommended fix in REE_assembly/evidence/planning/probe_warmup_nonbuffer_audit_2026-08-15.md.
items.resolution_note: APPLIED (governance cycle 2026-08-16, cranky-driscoll-126a36): V3-EXQ-784's informative_yield / target_met are recorded as PROVISIONAL on both SD-074 and MECH-063 via evidence_quality_note (a note was inserted on each -- neither claim previously carried one). The controlled 2-seed replication is what makes this decisive rather than theoretical: budget-0 control cells came back bit-identical as required, while all six post-first-read cells differed by 0.011-0.146 on D_action_mass and TWO OF SIX FLIPPED THE SATURATION REGIME -- the exact classification 784's headline counts. items.summary: MECH-091 is orphaned from V3 closure accounting and CANNOT be resolved without a governance DECISION that has never been made: the generation of SD-006 phase 2 (async multi-rate loop execution). Surfaced by D-002 (Steward orphan-V3-claim detector) and adjudicated 2026-08-15 in REE_assembly 7478ffe8ad; it was the one of four findings deliberately left UNDETERMINED, because picking a status would be guessing. The thing MECH-091 actually requires -- phase 2 async -- is NOT built, has ZERO entries in evidence/planning/substrate_queue.json, and carries no generation label anywhere in the repo. There is no artefact saying it is V3 and none saying it is V4. In the work-graph debt vocabulary this is a `puzzle (known rules)`: the missing thing is a FACT, not a build. MECHANISM: a deferral keyed to an external substrate that was never scoped. GAP-7 was registered 2026-05-08 with blocking_external 'SD-006 phase 2 async heartbeat' and deferred on that basis -- reasonable ONLY if something else then carries phase 2, and nothing does. It never reached substrate_queue.json, so no scoping pass, no IGW auto-discovery and no /implement-substrate route can ever see it, and the deferral became permanent by omission rather than by decision. Both EXQ-133 runs (2026-03-28 and the 2026-04-21 rerun) were reclassified non_contributory for exactly this substrate gap -- twice, explicitly 'NOT a falsification'. TWO SIGNALS ON THE NODE ALREADY CONTRADICT ITS OWN STATUS: its live block (as_of 2026-08-13, failure_autopsy_mech266-464e-467e-cluster) carries next 'routing=implement-substrate', i.e. the latest autopsy says the next step is to BUILD something, which is not what `deferred` means; and it is the ONLY node in the D-002 batch carrying needs_review TRUE (needs_review_reasons ['newest_forward_predates_later_decision_event(s)']) -- the repo's own staleness machinery had flagged it and nothing acted, for over three months. WHAT /governance MUST DECIDE, IN ORDER -- the first step is a decision, not an edit: (a) DECIDE the generation of SD-006 phase 2 and RECORD it. If V3 -> add an SD-006-phase-2 entry to substrate_queue.json and set commitment_closure:GAP-7 `blocked` (weight 0.1, +1 to the V3 denominator). If V4 -> keep GAP-7 `deferred` and CORRECT claims.yaml MECH-091 implementation_phase v3 -> v4. Either way the orphan closes. What is NOT acceptable is the current state, where neither is recorded and the claim is invisible to both the V3 denominator and the substrate queue. (b) Clear needs_review on GAP-7 once (a) lands. DECISION SUPPORT IN FLIGHT: chip chip-20260815-sd006-phase2-generation-brief (spawned 2026-08-15, TASK_CHIPS.json) is assembling evidence/planning/sd006_phase2_generation_brief.md -- what phase 2 concretely requires against the real ree-v3 substrate, the full blast radius (every claim/node/queue entry blocked on it, not just MECH-091), whether any prior artefact ever stated its generation, and BOTH branches pre-specified so this decision is a pick rather than a design task. BRIEF LANDED 2026-08-15T07:34Z (session modest-gauss-a38f51, chip-20260815-sd006-phase2-generation-brief) -- the 'DECISION SUPPORT IN FLIGHT' above is COMPLETE: evidence/planning/sd006_phase2_generation_brief.md is DECISION-READY. items.summary: EXTENDS GFLAG-0039 (same MECH-151 finding; read that first, this adds independent verification, a measured correction, and a repair-site routing -- it does not restate it). GFLAG-0039's source trace is CONFIRMED independently and is now contract-pinned (ree-v3 tests/contracts/test_exp0155_action_bias_no_scoring_authority.py, a1d49706): candidate scores are BIT-IDENTICAL at action_bias=None vs 1e3 (including with the wanting/curiosity/MECH-267 mode terms all enabled), elite ordering is unchanged, and in a matched-RNG pass the first differing scoring call is exactly the iteration-1 boundary -- so the CEM refit is demonstrably the sole channel, and at num_cem_iterations=1 the bias is bit-identically inert end to end. THREE CORRECTIONS/ADDITIONS. (1) 'Rigid translation of the CEM proposal mean' must not be read as behaviourally inert: measured, that translation passes through the nonlinear action_object_decoder and flips the entire final candidate pool's first-action class, so action_bias steers WHERE proposals are drawn while never ranking WHICH one wins -- the ao_mean += b / ao_std-unchanged identity is exact in real arithmetic but only to float32 eps in practice (rel err 1.2e-7 at b=1e3, 1e-16 in float64), so it must not be pinned bit-exactly. (2) GFLAG-0039 states the 1-of-16 slot-bank degeneracy 'would make cue_context near-constant'; that is now MEASURED, not inferred -- at fresh init the ContextMemory slot-selection entropy is 2.7726 == ln(16) exactly uniform and the divergence of cue_context itself is 0.000e+00. (3) This also RESOLVES EXP-0155 by refuting its premise, which bears on every V3-EXQ-418/418a/418b FAIL attributed to a downstream blocker: action_bias_divergence is computed directly on e1.extract_cue_context() output with zero calls into HippocampalModule, E2 rollout or E3.select, so nothing downstream can move it and its exact 0.0 is the upstream degeneracy above (chip-20260816-implsub-contextmemory-writepath-degeneracy), not a forward-path defect. ROUTING for governance to adjudicate: ARC-007 STRICT ('HippocampalModule generates VALUE-FLAT proposals ... E3 introduces ALL weighting') forbids fixing this in _score_trajectory, and MECH-151's own notes ('E1 biases which action-objects RANK HIGHLY, but E3 still selects') are satisfiable only where E3 selects -- but e3_selector.py has zero references to action_object/action_bias, i.e. E3 has no action-object input channel at all. MECH-151's asserted elevate/suppress ranking mechanism is therefore unimplemented rather than merely untrained; its live_status 'supports' reading (V3-EXQ-922, 2026-08-13) should be re-read against that.

items.summary: MECH-152's owed MEASUREMENT redesign (per confirmed failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-922a_2026-08-16) was fully designed this session but deliberately NOT QUEUED: /queue-experiment Step 2.5c fires at severity=corrupting on the open substrate_queue entry contextmemory-write-path-addressing-degeneracy (pending_implementation, substrate_paths ree_core/predictors/e1_deep.py), which is the module that computes terrain_weight. Same substrate and same gating decision as chip-20260818-sd017-ceiling-retest-gated (2026-08-18 governance) and the config GFLAG-0039 flags for MECH-151. TWO MEASURED FINDINGS, full detail in REE_assembly/evidence/planning/mech152_measurement_redesign_gated_20260818.md. (1) The write-path defect REPRODUCES on current substrate: 3000 low-variance writes addressed only 2 of 16 slots, corroborating 436e/436f. MECH-152 is strictly worse placed than MECH-151 here, because terrain_weight = sigmoid(cue_terrain_proj(cue_context)) has NO direct z_world path -- unlike action_bias, which retains the raw z_world channel via the EXQ-449a concat -- so z_world reaches terrain_weight ONLY through slot selection, and attainable modulation depth is exactly the per-slot spread of terrain_weight (a tight bound: selection weights are a convex combination and the remaining maps are linear plus monotone sigmoid). That is why A0_OFF, sitting at exactly the uniform saddle ln(16)=2.7726, showed w_harm_std 3.75e-07. (2) CORRECTION to the natural over-reading of (1): the degenerate bank does NOT make the asserted 0.6 swing unreachable. cue_terrain_proj is a trainable linear map and can amplify a small slot difference to saturation -- measured, best-case training reaches depth 0.6056 (100.9% of the asserted 0.6, w_harm in [0.198,0.803]) even on the 2-slot defect bank, versus 0.0110 untrained. What the defect actually costs is the number of representable contexts (capped at occupied slots, measured 2 -- coincidentally just enough for MECH-152's binary distinction, which is why a run would look CLEAN) and above all ATTRIBUTION, since those 2 slots are an argmin fixed-point artifact and are not context-organised. So what MECH-152 is owed remains a MEASUREMENT redesign, GATED on the ContextMemory fix, not superseded by it -- do not route MECH-152 to a substrate build or a demotion on the strength of the flat outputs. PROMOTES NOTHING, DEMOTES NOTHING; the 2026-08-16 HELD demote_to_candidate still should not be applied.

items.summary: ARC-004 FAILS its own registered what_would_answer, measured 2026-08-26. First execution of that falsifier -- its own text records the claim 'has never been tested as its own claim (absent from claim_evidence.v1.json) -- it is currently assumed via 36 dependents architecture, not measured'. PASS requires half-life(z_delta) > half-life(z_theta) > half-life(z_beta) by >= 0.8 SD of the seed-to-seed delta. Measured at 3 operating points, 5 seeds each (distinct stack init AND input stream), 1500 ticks: synthetic AR(1) rho=0.5 -> 1/5 seeds, margin +0.043 vs bar 0.060; rho=0.95 -> 1/5 seeds, margin +0.041 vs bar 0.653; REAL CausalGridWorld rollout -> 0/5 seeds, margin -0.159 vs bar 0.142, i.e. INVERTED (z_delta persists SHORTER than z_beta on every seed). Mechanism is transparent and read from source: alpha_shared=0.3 is a bare hardcoded literal applied identically to all three depths (stack.py:1454; note alpha_self/alpha_world ARE configurable, alpha_shared is not), and the beta->theta->delta cascade is a chain of UNTRAINED static projections (MECH-523), which change values but not temporal correlation -- so each depth inherits its input timescale under one identical EMA. White-noise control confirms: at rho=0 all three measure 1.89-1.91 against the EMA-alone prediction ln(0.5)/ln(0.7)=1.94. ARC-004's own FAIL branch prescribes the consequence: layers differ in content, not timescale; 'multi-timescale' is the wrong description of why they work; supersession review of the framing, structurally analogous to MECH-058 (asserted timescale separation for z_self/z_world, tested by lag-k autocorrelation in V3-EXQ-019, FAILED, retired, superseded by MECH-069 'incommensurable domains'). NO STATUS CHANGED HERE -- ARC-004 is active/standard with 36 dependents and this is governance's call. LIMITS, stated: encoders untrained (the as-built condition per MECH-523, and the condition ARC-004's own precondition frames, but a trained stack is untested); random-action policy on the real rollout; the 210-dim observation was split in half for body/world rather than using canonical channel routing, which should be redone before any supersession decision; the optional MECH-423 per-layer convergence corroboration was not run. Full write-up: evidence/planning/arc004_timescale_stratification_probe_20260826.md (REE_assembly 84d7260cb4).
items.resolution_note: APPLIED REE_assembly 3444b9f632. Disposition: NARROW + reclassify ARC-004 to substrate_conditional, NOT supersede (user-approved 2026-09-01). This flag read the 2026-08-26 FAIL as evidence against timescale stratification, citing the MECH-058 precedent. Both halves of that argument were checked and both fail: (a) the MECH-058 citation was wrong in three respects -- the retirement PREDATES the cited run by two days, rested on a learning-rate ablation not lag-k autocorrelation, and that run's timescale criteria C1/C2 both PASSED (corrected inline in ARC-004's what_would_answer); (b) per GFLAG-0088 the falsifier could never have passed, so the FAIL is evidence about the implementation, not the claim. ARC-004 now carries an evidence_quality_note (it had none) recording all of this, plus the measurement that serial smoothing reaches the claim's own PASS bar at +4.342 vs a 0.510 bar, 10/10 seeds.

items.resolution_note: UPHELD, applied REE_assembly 008d91c0ce. Verified by independent recomputation from the 785a per-tick sink (n=1765): the five percentiles this claim quoted are the POOLED-ACROSS-FIVE-SEEDS distribution (pooled IQR/median 0.5133), while post-warmup WITHIN-seed IQR/median is 0.0116/0.0104/0.0729/0.0848/0.0193 and seed medians span 2.6x. MECH-465's what_would_answer now records reachability as OPEN and measured NEGATIVE, and the P2 dispersion floor is marked SCORE-PER-SEED -- as written it was simultaneously unsatisfiable per-seed (max 0.085 vs a 0.51 bar) and silently passable if scored pooled. items.summary: DIRECT CONTRADICTION, same code path. MECH-092 (via depends_on MECH-289, Gupta 2010) asserts anti-recency: under-sampled paths replayed MORE. MECH-205 Refinement D (Mattar and Daw 2018) asserts priority = PE x NEED: a high-PE episode in a region the agent will never revisit has zero need and is NOT prioritised. For a rare/high-PE/low-revisit region these predict OPPOSITE allocations, and both are instantiated on the SAME drive_state vector consumed by HippocampalModule.replay() start-selection, so at most one can be operative. Neither claim acknowledges the other. A single 3-cell probe (high-PE/high-need, high-PE/low-need, low-PE/high-need) adjudicates both.
items.resolution_note: APPLIED REE_assembly da501b6c23 (sub-decision D1-a). CONTRADICTION DISSOLVED, residue recorded as a design constraint on SD-038. It dissolves twice: TEXTUALLY the two claims govern different stages (MECH-092 anchor/start selection, MECH-205 proposal distribution) and each says so itself; SUBSTANTIVELY MECH-289's anti-recency is wired NOWHERE -- SD-038 is ready:false, its hint reads 'not implemented', and no anti-recency code exists in ree_core -- so at most one mechanism exists and they cannot conflict now. The flag was raised against a REAL risk and is dissolved as a CURRENT contradiction, not dismissed as a future one: the note lives on SD-038 because that is where the risk becomes real, recording that building anti-recency WITHOUT reconciling it against PE x NEED at the shared drive_state write is what would create the predicted conflict. The flag's own 3-cell probe is adopted verbatim as the adjudicator for that build.

items.summary: GFLAG-0055 reads ARC-004's 2026-08-26 FAIL as evidence against timescale stratification, citing the MECH-058 supersession precedent. items.summary: The 2026-08-26 ARC-004 probe (GFLAG-0055) reports 'on the real environment the margin is not merely below the bar -- it points the WRONG way: z_delta's half-life is shorter than z_beta's on every seed' (-0.159, 0/5 seeds). That direction claim does not reproduce and should not be quoted in a supersession review; the FAIL verdict itself is robust and is strengthened. Re-run on the real LatentStack with canonical observation routing (body_obs_dim=10 / world_obs_dim=200 as CausalGridWorld declares, versus the predecessor's OBS//2 half-split at 105/105) across eight method variants -- routing x half-life estimator x action count x env seeding, 10 seeds each -- mean(delta - beta) spans -0.037 to +0.102 with every value far below its own 0.8*SD bar (0.33-0.56) and monotone-ordering count 2-4 of 10 throughout. The effect is indistinguishable from zero and its sign flips with choices carrying no theoretical weight. The predecessor's script, recovered from its session transcript, constructs CausalGridWorld() with no seed while seeding only torch and numpy, so it is not deterministic: re-running it as recovered gives -0.125 and -0.097 against its reported -0.159. Neither the estimator (the two agree to three decimals on identical trajectories) nor REEConfig.from_dims (checked field-by-field against a plain LatentStackConfig, identical) accounts for the difference. Detail and the arm A/B contrast in evidence/planning/arc004_wiring_topology_probe_20260828.md section 8.

items.summary: These six are the active/stable claims whose OWN what_would_answer declares a currently-unmet precondition and which no substrate_queue.unblocks_claims entry and no IGW ledger/assignments entry names -- i.e. they are treated as settled while their own test is unrunnable and nothing is building what would make it runnable. The disposition question is which of the six that is APPROPRIATE for: INV-025 (irreducible uncertainty cannot be engineered away), INV-028 and INV-029 are plausibly aleatoric-irreducible in the work-graph debt vocabulary and legitimately owe no substrate build, whereas ARC-003 ('E3 selects and commits trajectories') is a core architectural commitment and Q-007/Q-015 are open questions, for which an unrunnable falsifier reads as neglect rather than irreducibility. No field currently distinguishes the two cases, which is why every audit re-litigates it. Wider context, measured 2026-08-28: of 507 claims carrying a written falsifier, 185 self-declare an unmet precondition and 121 (65%) have no route on either channel, 43 of them phase v3, median age 69 days and 26 older than 90 days; several of the unrouted DO name a specific blocker but do so in prose inside what_would_answer/notes where no routing process reads it. items.summary: PIPELINE DEFECT (GOV-APPLY-1 detector; the five claims are the concrete instances). All 8 rows in check_unapplied_autopsy_recommendations.py's unapplied_disposition ACTIONABLE bucket were VERIFIED APPLIED on 2026-09-01 and are FALSE POSITIVES. Cause: _target_state() cannot parse the free-prose per_claim_recommendation[].change text recent autopsies write -- every one of the 8 returns field_hint=None with a target_state that is a sentence fragment ('set pending_retest_after_substrate false', 'non_contributory. Nothing storable moves -- apply the corrected note', "1.0) is CONFIRMED by WAKING_ONLY = 0.9993..."), so no compare can certify it. _STAMP_RE also misses a citation recommendation phrased 'stamp ... this artifact' instead of naming the slug (the V3-EXQ-571b MECH-439 row, applied this cycle). Verified per row: ARC-045/SD-017 carry the 966-cluster note + WRITE-PATH-CONTENT re-scoping and live_status cites the cluster; SD-078/SD-082 both read pending_retest_after_substrate false with the withdrawals recorded; MECH-439 cites failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-571b_2026-09-01. The two 436e rows are additionally superseded by the 966-cluster, which superseded_disposition cannot detect because certifying a supersession requires the LATER recommendation to be parseable and it is not -- the defect cascades. This is the alarm-fatigue Goodhart vector the codebase warns about: a warn bucket that re-reports applied work every cycle gets accepted by default, and a real unapplied disposition would hide among them. Fix is two-sided: (a) producer -- /failure-autopsy should end every per_claim_recommendation.change on a machine-checkable tail ('-> <field>: <value>' or 'stamp <literal-slug>'); (b) detector -- treat an unparseable change as UNCERTIFIABLE and report it in its own bucket rather than as ACTIONABLE. Do NOT fix by re-applying: a mechanical apply pass would have double-appended five evidence_quality_notes.

items.summary: STRENGTHENS AND EXTENDS GFLAG-0100 (read that one first) -- second confirmed instance of the same check_substrate_ceiling_audit.py partial-satisfaction defect, so the finding is a predicate bug rather than a one-off. The ceiling-may-have-lifted predicate fires when ANY ONE substrate_queue entry listing the claim in unblocks_claims reaches status implemented, not when the claim's ACTUAL retest gate is satisfied. Verified 2026-09-01: SD-017 was flagged because SD-016 is implemented, but SD-017 has THREE unblockers and the live gate is contextmemory-write-path-addressing-degeneracy, still implemented_pending_validation -- and confirmed failure_autopsy_966-436g-951-959-822d-cluster_2026-08-30 had ALREADY re-scoped SD-017's pending_retest_after_substrate from after-SD-016-armed to after-WRITE-PATH-CONTENT, so the flag cites a gate governance moved past two days before it fired. ARC-030 re-confirmed current the same day: of its six unblockers, mech457_competence_bootstrap_explorer remains blocked_pending_dependency on MECH-229 (status provisional, implementation_phase v3), exactly as GFLAG-0100 recorded. NO RETEST IS OWED ON EITHER CLAIM and pending_retest_after_substrate correctly stays true on both; no claims.yaml change made this cycle. Cost of leaving it: this is an ACTIONABLE bucket that surfaces to AskUserQuestion every cycle for work that does not exist -- the same alarm-fatigue Goodhart vector GFLAG-0107 records for GOV-APPLY-1, and the park/self-handled exclusions exist precisely so ACTIONABLE stays rare enough to read. Proposed fix: require ALL entries listing the claim in unblocks_claims to be terminal (or the claim's own re-scoped retest gate to be named and satisfied) before ceiling_may_have_lifted fires; a partially-satisfied unblocker set should report as its own advisory bucket, not ACTIONABLE.
items.resolution_note: Fixed at the predicate level: REE_assembly 94c11a05b4 (scripts/check_substrate_ceiling_audit.py). ceiling_may_have_lifted now requires ALL non-moot unblocking substrate_queue entries to be status==implemented, not just one; a partially-satisfied set stays in mapped with an informational retest_partial note instead of firing ACTIONABLE. Also closed a regression the fix would otherwise have introduced: moving ARC-030/SD-017 into mapped newly exposed them to the GOV-CEIL-1 exhaustion overlay (10 and 4 ceiling hits, both >= N=3), which would have recommended demoting both -- fixed by exempting retest_partial claims from that overlay too (a fully-unbuilt mapped claim still gets no exemption, unchanged). Re-ran the audit post-fix: ceiling-may-have-lifted ACTIONABLE=0, ceiling-exhausted ACTIONABLE=0, ARC-030 and SD-017 both correctly report as partial/informational only. Verified via full audit diff across all 31 substrate_ceiling claims (old vs new): only these two change bucket, no other claim affected. GOV-HELDOUT-1 run: could not find 3 non-degenerate held-out cases beyond the two motivating instances (full-corpus diff shows zero other claims change), so this ships incident-scoped per the documented fallback. NO retest is owed on either ARC-030 or SD-017 -- confirms GFLAG-0100's and this flag's own analysis; no claims.yaml change made.

items.summary: RESIDUAL of GFLAG-0106 (read that one first; it is resolved). Governance re-derived v4_spec's V3 full-completion gate on 2026-09-01 into MECH-477 + MECH-478 + MECH-479, and the user explicitly RETAINED MECH-479 in the V3 gate against the GOV-V4CUT-1 audit's proposal to move it to V4-phase validation. MECH-479 nevertheless still carries implementation_phase: v4, and the audit's stated ground for moving it was that testing prosocial_planning_requires_planned_system structurally requires V4-1 (others-as-slots, ARC-083). So the gate is now coherent in intent but inconsistent in labelling: a V3 completion gate names a v4-phase claim whose test has a v4 precondition. DECISION OWED, one of two: (i) let MECH-479's implementation_phase follow the dependency to v3 -- consistent with the standing rule that phase label follows dependency, and with the user's own reasoning that a V3 gate does not shed a hard leg; or (ii) re-derive the V4-1 precondition so the prosocial-planning leg is testable in V3 without others-as-slots, e.g. against a scripted or degenerate second agent. Do NOT resolve this by reverting to the old 'MECH-163 validated' wording -- that was unsatisfiable for a worse reason (it named a claim whose legs had been split out to MECH-478/479). Note the interaction with the still-open GFLAG-0105: the user's reading there is that MECH-274/276/278/ARC-031 may likewise be v3 prerequisites rather than V4, so option (i) may be one instance of a broader correction rather than a one-off.
items.resolution_note: RESOLVED BY USER DECISION, 2026-09-01, applied REE_assembly 008d91c0ce. MECH-479 MOVES TO V4 and is removed from the V3 full-completion gate, which is now MECH-477 + MECH-478. This REVERSES the retention recorded earlier the same day. The retention principle -- a V3 gate does not shed a leg merely because that leg is hard to test -- stands and is not withdrawn; what changed is a measurement put to the user: MECH-479's falsifier requires a SECOND AGENT whose integrated z_harm_a is measurable, and ree-v3/ree_core/environment/ contains exactly one file (causal_grid_world.py) with no multi-agent support of any kind. The leg is therefore not hard to test in V3 but UNTESTABLE in V3, and retaining it made the gate permanently unclosable rather than merely demanding. Gate and label now agree (the claim already carried implementation_phase v4), so the KNOWN TENSION recorded in v4_spec.md is resolved rather than deferred. NOT a dropped obligation -- a V4-phase validation item. Noted for later: the falsifier requires both arms to PERCEIVE the other agent, which is weaker than modelling it as an agent, so the leg may not need full others-as-slots (ARC-083) once a multi-agent environment exists.

items.summary: HELD RESIDUAL of the MECH-317 partial-absorption disposition applied 2026-09-01 (REE_assembly 970117ca29; memo docs/architecture/mech_317_absorption_check.md; parents GFLAG-0066 and GFLAG-0087, both now resolved -- read 0087's resolution for why this was split out). ONE QUESTION, DELIBERATELY NOT ANSWERED BY THAT PASS: should MECH-318's and MECH-312b's depends_on edges to MECH-317 move to the ARC-071/MECH-323/MECH-324 cluster, or stay? The case for staying, which is why the pass declined to act: verdict (B) was PARTIAL absorption, so MECH-317 SURVIVES (narrowed to the action-stream boundary-readout claim, epistemic_category now substrate_conditional). A surviving claim's inbound edges are not automatically stale, and GFLAG-0087's 'repoint both' recommendation was written against the FULL supersede that was subsequently refused on the evidence tree -- so acting on it now would be applying a remedy for a disposition that did not happen. The case for moving: what MECH-318 and MECH-312b actually consume from MECH-317 is the COMPRESSION MECHANISM (MECH-318 abstracts the rule state under which the compressed options are deployed; MECH-312b weights arbitration by practice maturity over them), and that mechanism has moved -- it now lives in ARC-071/MECH-323/MECH-324. Post-narrowing, MECH-317 carries only the DV. So both consumers may now be pointing at a claim that no longer asserts the thing they depend on. VERIFIED FACTS EITHER WAY: no ARC-071-family claim mentions rule-state abstraction or practice-maturity weighting anywhere in its record, so a naive repoint would create edges into claims that assert neither; and MECH-312b is absent from GFLAG-0066's and GFLAG-0087's claim_ids entirely, so any disposition applied from those flags' claim lists alone would have orphaned it silently -- it is named here so that cannot recur. A third option exists and may be the right one: SPLIT the edge, pointing the mechanism dependency at the ARC-071 cluster while retaining a DV dependency on MECH-317 where the consumer genuinely needs the boundary readout. Decidable at a desk from the three consumers' own text; needs no run.
items.resolution_note: RESOLVED AT THE DESK, applied REE_assembly (repoint commit). MOVE, not stay and not split. What MECH-318 and MECH-312b consume from MECH-317 is the COMPRESSION MECHANISM, and that mechanism moved in the 2026-09-01 partial absorption: MECH-323 is the chunk FORMATION operator, MECH-324 the MAINTENANCE operator, ARC-071 the parent. Post-narrowing MECH-317 carries only the entropy-trough boundary-readout DV and NEITHER consumer uses it -- so the DV dependency that the third (split) option existed to preserve does not exist, and a split would have created an edge nothing needs. MECH-318 -> MECH-323; MECH-312b -> MECH-323 + MECH-324 (crystallisation and persistence under corroboration IS practice maturity, that claim's own subject). THE FLAG'S HESITATION IS ANSWERED RATHER THAN OVERRIDDEN: it noted that no ARC-071-family claim mentions rule-state abstraction or practice-maturity weighting and read that as a reason to stay. Verified true -- both counts are zero across all three claims -- but those are the CONSUMERS' own content, not what they depend on; a dependency need not restate its dependant. MECH-312b was correctly named here: it is absent from GFLAG-0066's and GFLAG-0087's claim_ids, so a disposition driven off those lists alone would have orphaned it silently.

items.summary: RESIDUAL of GFLAG-0105 (read that one first; it is resolved). ARC-059's own depends_on list spans all 3 developmental stages it names (self-as-object, objects-as-patterns, others-as-special-objects) including MECH-274 and MECH-278, both just relabeled implementation_phase: v4 with phase_locked: true because their own content genuinely needs V4 substrate (MECH-274: multi-agent modelling, zero substrate exists; MECH-278: object-schema-via-intervention, explicitly BYPASSED in V3 per object_representation_v4_plan.md). check_claim_phase_consistency.py now correctly reports these as CONFLICT (ARC-059 -> MECH-274, ARC-059 -> MECH-278) instead of silently re-deriving v3 on MECH-274/278. ARC-059 itself (implementation_phase: v3, v3_pending: true) is a claim ABOUT the ordering across all 3 stages -- its own scope may be over-broad for a single v3 label, since stage 3 (others-as-special-objects) is structurally V4 territory (needs another agent to exist). DECISION OWED: either (a) SPLIT ARC-059 per the F1-F4 pattern (minimal v3 form = stages 1-2 ordering only, self-as-object -> objects-as-patterns; v4 form = the full 3-stage claim including others), routing to /claim-synthesis, or (b) sever/retype the ARC-059->MECH-274 and ARC-059->MECH-278 depends_on edges if ARC-059's own v3-testable content genuinely does not need those specific specializations built. SECOND, SMALLER DEFECT surfaced in the same pass: MECH-276<->MECH-278 is a reciprocal depends_on cycle -- MECH-276's depends_on list includes MECH-278 (commented '# stage-2 specialisation'), which is backwards; MECH-278 already correctly lists MECH-276 as ITS dependency (the general principle a specialization depends on). check_claim_phase_consistency.py now flags this as a LOAD-BEARING cycle since MECH-276 stayed v3 (real substrate confirmed, GFLAG-0105) while MECH-278 moved to v4. Not fixed here (adjacent to but outside GFLAG-0105's exact 4-claim scope) -- the erroneous edge in MECH-276's depends_on should simply be deleted.

items.summary: PIPELINE DEFECT (dry-run filter blind spot; the three V3-EXQ-395 smokes are the concrete instance). generate_pending_review.load_dry_run_run_ids() and check_dry_run_citations.build_index() both enumerate only TWO manifest shapes -- EVIDENCE_DIR.glob('*.json') (top-level flat) and EVIDENCE_DIR.glob('*/runs/*/manifest.json') (canonical packs). A THIRD shape exists in the corpus and matches NEITHER: the per-experiment-type flat manifest at evidence/experiments/<type>/<run_id>.json, one directory deep with no pack. Consequence: for a manifest of that shape, setting dry_run:true has NO EFFECT on any guard -- pending_review's dry exclusion cannot see it, check_dry_run_citations reports 'no manifest on disk', and GOV-DRY-1 (which keys on the same index) reports 0 asserting dry stamps while an asserting dry stamp is live. Confirmed 2026-09-02: the three v3_exq_395_mech220_harm_hub_dry_* manifests had dry_run UNSET and two carried evidence_direction weakens against MECH-220 with scoring_excluded None -- the ONLY experimental rows against that claim, alongside three literature supports, which is what generated its hold_candidate_resolve_conflict. Governance contained them (dry_run true, non_contributory, note; REE_assembly 20ac9d7cab) and they STILL appear in the regenerated pending_review FAIL bucket, because the glob cannot reach them. GFLAG-0111's six flat-only manifests (V3-EXQ-542/544/544a supports, 395 x2 weakens, 259 does_not_support) are the same shape and the same exposure. Recommend: add EVIDENCE_DIR.glob('*/*.json') (excluding runs/ and _NON_MANIFEST_FILES) to both enumerators, with a regression test pinning all three shapes; then re-run GOV-DRY-1, which is currently reporting a false 0.

items.summary: PIPELINE DEFECT (general; ARC-073 and EXT-003 are the concrete instances). The promotion generator raises hold_candidate_resolve_conflict from a conflict_ratio that does not distinguish a LITERATURE-only conflict from an EXPERIMENTAL one, so a claim with genuine_exp_count=0 can be held for 'conflict resolution' by a counterweight paper that a /lit-pull recorded DELIBERATELY (EXT-003: Silver 2021, capped 0.50 for evidentiary FORM; ARC-073: Smith 1991 alongside 2 supports + 2 mixed). USER RULING at the /governance 2026-09-03 Step 3 gate: a literature-only evidence conflict should NOT halt things -- it may legitimately motivate broader hypothesis-space testing, but experimental evidence of working mechanisms is the load-bearing channel (cf. feedback_lit_exp_decoupled, which already holds that lit and exp evidence are not co-equal). Both instances were dispositioned applied this cycle with the reasoning recorded in claims.yaml evidence_quality_note, so they stop re-flagging; the GENERAL behaviour is unfixed and will keep manufacturing lit-only holds. Fix direction: make the conflict-driven hold gate on experimental conflict, and route a lit-only conflict to a hypothesis-space/fan-out surface instead of a promotion hold.

items.summary: EXT-005's registered wording ('LLMs can produce fluent causal language without ANY internal mechanism that computes a genuine causal signature') is contradicted as written by Kiciman et al. 2024 (TMLR), which reports GPT-3.5/4 at 97% pairwise causal discovery, 92% counterfactual reasoning and 86% on necessary-and-sufficient-cause vignettes, with robustness checks showing the results survive on post-training-cutoff datasets -- recorded as the 'weakens' entry in the new targeted_review_ext_005 pull (REE_assembly 6dbbb15509, 5 entries, lit_confidence 0 -> 0.772). The narrowed claim that DOES survive the pull, and that REE's SD-029/ARC-037 cluster actually answers, is the absence of a FIRST-PERSON, RUN-TIME causal signature over the agent's own interventions: Kiciman's own stated qualifier is that LLMs 'operate on the text metadata' and 'ignore the actual data', and no task in that paper (or in Zecevic 2023 or Jin 2024) tests agent-caused vs world-caused attribution at all. Recommend governance re-word EXT-005 to the narrowed form rather than leave a blanket-absence claim standing against contrary measurement.
items.resolution_note: Applied by governance-20260903T2013 after V3-EXQ-995 PASS: claims.yaml EXT-005 -- title narrowed to a first-person, run-time causal-signature mechanism over the agent own interventions (the reading Kiciman 2024 leaves untested and the one 995 measured); Kiciman weakens entry stands against the OLD wording, lit-only conflict non-gating per the 2026-09-03 user ruling. items.summary: V3-EXQ-978 (SD-018 directional-field validation, FAIL, autopsy failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-978_2026-09-03 ratified non_contributory) carries an eval-protocol confound inside its competence DV that the autopsy did not record. The fishtank episode log (seed 42, 6 OFF + 6 ON episodes, frozen policies) shows the greedy-argmax eval reader (x737 LatentPPOEvalPolicy) falling into a deterministic two-cell limit cycle in 9 of 12 episodes; the causal-footprint contamination rule (+0.5 per visit, cell retyped contaminated at 2.0, 0.4 health per contaminated step) then kills the agent at step 11-23 in a hazard-free D3 env, so every dithering episode ends health_depleted with ~11 steps of foraging opportunity against 200. The other 3 episodes are a fixed-point wall-press (198/200 stationary). PPO trains by sampling and never experiences its own argmax cycle, which is why the reader scores 0.27 res/ep BELOW the random_walk anchor (1.05, survives ~48 steps). Consequences: (1) the arm contrast is compressed toward zero by episode truncation regardless of what z_world carries, so the OFF/ON null is weaker evidence than the manifest reads; (2) the chip-20260903-exq978-oracle-adapter-discriminator follow-on (H-B/H-C, zworld_actor_adequacy_locus) should pre-register a stochastic or contamination-off eval, or a survival-normalised DV, else the same truncation will mask the adapter contrast. Not a re-test request; INV-088/MECH-457 dispositions stand. Evidence: per-step pos/health/transition_type in the 978 episode log companion (Mac + hub copies, placemarker on origin).
items.resolution_note: HOLDS-AS-STATED -- edit applied in REE_assembly be59b22b21 (gov-flagbacklog-20260909; user cleared the spot-check gate and approved the docket 2026-09-10). I re-derived the confound independently from the in-repo episode log rather than taking the flag on report, and the mechanism is exactly as described, with two count corrections. The env is D3_hazard_free (num_hazards 0, recorded in the log's env_config) yet ree_core/environment/causal_grid_world.py:135-140 defaults contamination_spread 0.5, contamination_threshold 2.0, contaminated_harm 0.4, and the module's own docstring at :71-78 and :180-196 warns that 'hazard-free probes contaminate themselves to death' (SD-094) unless contamination_spread=0.0 or hazard_free_contamination_gate=True is passed -- V3-EXQ-978 passes neither (env kwargs come from x724.ENV_KWARGS via x734._env_kwargs_for_rung, neither of which sets them). Measured from the seed-42 log (12 episodes, 6 OFF + 6 ON): 10 of 12 end at health 0.0 between steps 11 and 23, each with 3 terminal agent_caused_hazard transitions, and 9 of 12 visit 4 or fewer distinct cells. Total resource events across all 12 episodes: 2. The manifest's random_walk anchor is foraging_competence 1.05, survival_horizon 48.1 -- exactly the figures the flag cites. The autopsy records the SYMPTOMS (both arms at/below the random-walk anchor, ON death_rate 0.95/0.0/0.55, survival_horizon 25.35/200.0/97.15, 'Environment: too sparse') but nowhere names the greedy-argmax dithering plus self-contamination mechanism, so 'the autopsy did not record it' is fair. APPLIED: Two edits, no re-test. (1) evidence/planning/failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-978_2026-09-03.md/.json -- amend section 2 (or add an addendum) recording the eval-protocol confound: the greedy-argmax eval reader (x737.LatentPPOEvalPolicy) dithers in a small cell footprint and the SD-094 self-contamination rule then kills it by step 11-23 in a hazard-free env, so the OFF/ON arm contrast is compressed by episode truncation independent of what z_world carries; the null is therefore weaker evidence than the manifest reads. Do NOT change the non_contributory disposition or the INV-088/MECH-457 tags. (2) The chip-20260903-exq978-oracle-adapter-discriminator follow-on (H-B/H-C, zworld_actor_adequacy_locus) must pre-register either a stochastic eval policy, contamination_spread=0.0 / hazard_free_contamination_gate=True, or a survival-normalised DV -- record that as a hard readiness gate on the chip before it is queued. Citations: evidence/experiments/v3_exq_978_sd018_directional_field_fishtank/runs/v3_exq_978_sd018_directional_field_fishtank_20260903T111718Z_v3/v3_exq_978_sd018_directional_field_fishtank_20260903T111718Z_episode_log.json, evidence/experiments/v3_exq_978_sd018_directional_field_fishtank_20260903T111718Z_v3.json, evidence/planning/failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-978_2026-09-03.md:15. Record: evidence/planning/governance_flag_adjudication_20260909.md. RESIDUAL: Two numeric corrections to the flag, neither affecting the conclusion: it is 10 of 12 episodes that die at step 11-23 (not 9), and only 2 episodes run the full 200 steps (not 3) -- one of those two has a 5-cell footprint with 195 no-op steps rather than the described 198/200 wall-press. The '9 of 12' figure matches episodes with a footprint of 4 cells or fewer, not strictly two-cell (that is 4 episodes). Worth noting for the follow-on: this is a documented, opt-out-able env trap that the substrate's own docstring warns about, so the same gate should be added to any hazard-free probe in this lineage, not just this one.

items.summary: EXT-008's wording overstates its own anchor source. A full-text read of arXiv:2606.04455 (Meta-Agent Challenge) during the 2026-09-05 lit-pull found that the ground-truth exfiltration attempts occurred but were CONTAINED: the paper states isolation 'successfully neutralized every exploit attempt' and 'no flagged run artificially inflated its test score'. EXT-008's title and docs/architecture/evaluation_channel_integrity.md both say agents exfiltrated ground truth 'despite anti-reward-hacking protections', which reads as a successful collapse of the evidence loop into an optimisation loop; on the source, 'despite' holds for the ATTEMPT only, not the RESULT. Governance should decide whether to reword EXT-008 (and the architecture doc) to 'attempted exploitation under an intact boundary'. Note this is a favourable correction for INV-077: what held the line in MAC was structural (ground truth in a private container filesystem; the X-Verifier-Secret injected only after the development phase), matching INV-077's own what_would_answer insistence that confirmation come from the STRUCTURAL absence of a write path rather than from a review norm. items.resolution_note: APPLIED 2026-09-09 by /governance cycle governance-20260909 wave 4, user-adjudicated. REE_assembly 5616443506 (verified on origin/master): MECH-106 DEMOTED provisional -> candidate. Both of this flag's legs were independently verified before acting, not taken on report. (1) The degenerate criterion was re-derived NUMERICALLY: under the driver's own symmetric linear map base * (1 + 1.2 * (da - 0.5)), a da_divergence of exactly 0.20 -- the C1 bar -- already implies a threshold_asymmetry of 1.2727, which clears the C2 bar of 1.20, and the implied asymmetry rises monotonically thereafter (1.3529 at da_divergence 0.25, 1.4390 at 0.30). (2) The substrate-absence leg was verified by grep: 'valence_bias' appears nowhere under ree-v3/ree_core/, confirming the mechanism was implemented in the driver rather than the substrate. epistemic_category left at substrate_conditional -- that was correct and is not what moved. items.resolution_note: HOLDS-BUT-MISDIAGNOSED -- edit applied in REE_assembly be59b22b21 (gov-flagbacklog-20260909; user cleared the spot-check gate and approved the docket 2026-09-10). The sign flip is real and the line citation was accurate when raised. But the two claims do NOT make opposite-sign predictions. SD-011's post-flip code multiplies effective_threshold by (1.0 + urgency_applied) rising in z_harm_a; MECH-106's functional_restatement specifies the same operator in the same direction. The real defect is that MECH-106's PROSE carries the pre-2026-03-18 precision-space gloss, reading the gate as 'making it harder to commit' when the rule is committed = variance < effective_threshold, under which raising the threshold makes commitment MORE permissive. MECH-106 is internally inconsistent with its own formula, not in conflict with SD-011. APPLIED: Correct MECH-106, not the SD-011 code. Governance picks which half of MECH-106 is the claim: (A) KEEP THE ARITHMETIC and rewrite the prose into variance-space, which INVERTS the registered behavioural prediction and makes MECH-106 a same-sign sibling of SD-011; or (B) KEEP THE BEHAVIOUR and correct the formula to x(1 - valence_bias), putting MECH-106 in genuine opposition to the 2026-08-26 D2-escape rationale and requiring re-adjudication of that flip. Recommend (A) -- smaller edit, matches the direction the substrate already took; (B) preserves the Frank 2004/2005 D2 grounding, the harder thing to give up. Citations: ree-v3/ree_core/predictors/e3_selector.py:3774-3796, ree-v3/ree_core/predictors/e3_selector.py:3834, ree-v3/ree_core/predictors/e3_selector.py:3847. MECH-106 was demoted provisional -> candidate on 2026-09-09 under GFLAG-0163 partly for SUBSTRATE ABSENCE (valence_bias appears nowhere in ree_core/, re-verified). USER DECISION 2026-09-10: option (A) -- arithmetic kept, prose rewritten into variance-space. The narrowed-residual falsifier WAS applied to MECH-192 (claims.yaml:28254-28305: 'AS REGISTERED, MECH-192 IS NEARLY ANALYTIC... NARROWED RESIDUAL CLAIM: coordination benefit from z_beta leakage is monotone in signal legibility, holding attribution coupling and channel information fixed'), and a propose-only note was appended to its notes field (:28311), but the three things the proposal flags as needing an explicit decision were all deliberately left undone: the title still reads the old near-analytic form ('Signal legibility is prerequisite for fast empathy coordination...', :28241), the necessity-framing text has not migrated to MECH-191, and depends_on is still [MECH-183, MECH-191] without ARC-047 (:28251). DECISION AS APPLIED: Governance decision required; the discharging edits, if approved, are all in docs/claims/claims.yaml. See the options in notes. Record: evidence/planning/governance_flag_adjudication_20260909.md. RESIDUAL: DECISION FOR THE USER, stated cold. MECH-192 currently says one thing in its title and a materially narrower thing in its falsifier. Its registered title -- 'signal legibility is prerequisite for fast empathy coordination' -- is close to a definitional truth (there is no world in which a signal that maps onto nothing produces state-matching), which is why it has never been testable. A falsifier written on 2026-09-06 narrowed it to something that IS testable and that no other claim owns: coordination benefit rises with signal legibility when you hold the attribution coupling and the channel's information content fixed -- i.e. compare the true signal against a scrambled signal carrying identical information and energy. items.resolution_note: USER-APPROVED DECISION applied 2026-09-10 in REE_assembly c8116c399b (gov-flagbacklog-20260909; user read the docket and approved the recommendation). The factual half is confirmed exactly as stated: failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-597b_2026-05-23 routes '/queue-experiment -> V3-EXQ-597c' with next_queue_id 'V3-EXQ-597c' and the two-fix spec (dacc_bias_max_abs raised to 20.0, per-component telemetry), and no 597c exists anywhere -- ree-v3/experiments holds only v3_exq_597 and v3_exq_597b, ree-v3 contains zero matches for EXQ-597c/exq_597c, and no manifest or queue item names it. The artifact DID change since the flag was raised, and the change is not a discharge: commit 441f3ec099 (2026-09-08) added a ceiling_routing_note to MECH-258 (claims.yaml:40036-40047) parking the claim as ceiling_decision: deferred, and that note itself states 'the 2026-05-24-routed V3-EXQ-597c redesign remains unauthored (GFLAG-0211). Flags GFLAG-0210/0211/0212/0213 stay open.' Governance parked the claim without resolving the routing. DECISION AS APPLIED: Governance decision required. See notes for the three options; whichever is chosen, record it on MECH-258's ceiling_routing_note (claims.yaml:40036) and mark failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-597b_2026-05-23.json's routing as withdrawn or re-specified so the 597c pointer stops reading as a live obligation. Record: evidence/planning/governance_flag_adjudication_20260909.md. RESIDUAL: DECISION FOR THE USER, stated cold. On 2026-05-24 a confirmed post-mortem routed a follow-up experiment, V3-EXQ-597c, with a concrete two-part redesign. Three and a half months later it has never been written, queued or run, and nothing in the system treats that as an error -- the routing just sits there. Meanwhile the claim it belonged to (MECH-258) was parked on 2026-09-08 as substrate-ceilinged, and later measurement (V3-EXQ-862b, 2026-08-29) showed that one of the two prescribed fixes -- isolating the PE component for readout -- would produce an identity rather than a measurement, because the isolated quantity is a deterministic linear function of the thing it is meant to correlate with. The other fix (raising the bias clip) does not by itself lift the blocker that stops the experiment being interpretable at all (committed-action diversity is zero). OPTION A -- formally WITHDRAW the 597c routing as superseded by the ceiling reading. COST: the redesign spec's one still-valid element (raising dacc_bias_max_abs to 20.0) is lost unless copied into the claim's falsifier first. FORECLOSES: nothing permanently; a new letter can always be routed. OPTION B -- RE-SPECIFY 597c against MECH-258's current four-part precondition gate (P1 signal non-degeneracy, P2 PE-vs-raw separability, P3 arithmetic reachability of the scored measure, P4 committed-action diversity), which the claim already carries in full. COST: authoring effort now for an experiment that cannot run until the shared F-dominance blocker lifts. FORECLOSES: nothing. OPTION C -- leave it unexecuted, as now. COST: an open, unowned routing that every subsequent audit re-finds; the digestion pass that raised this called it 'the worst of the three'. RECOMMENDATION: Option A, with one carry-over. Withdraw the routing explicitly, and before doing so move the surviving instruction (raise dacc_bias_max_abs above the 2.0 clip that made 597b's output a constant) into MECH-258's what_would_answer P4 clause, where it will be read when the ceiling lifts. That keeps the one piece of the spec that measurement has not invalidated and removes a stale obligation that has been mistaken for live work twice already.

items.summary: The CONFIRMED failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-1007_2026-09-08 routing states 'k=4 broke the orbit in 1007', and the target run's own manifest does not establish it: persist_k4 reports orbit_period None on 20/20 episodes only because bounded_orbit_period needs 24 consecutive positions for period 8 (min_repeats 3) while every short k4 episode is 19-23 steps. A direct check of the driver's own detectors shows a k-latch RE-PERIODISES a period-2 cycle to period 2k rather than breaking it, so period2_cycle_present -- the detector primary criterion C1 routes on -- returns False by ARITHMETIC for every k>=2, at every episode length. C1 therefore cannot fail, and the successor V3-EXQ-1007a was authored, smoke-green, and NOT QUEUED on a red-team BLOCKING verdict. Neither claim's direction changes; the finding is that the predecessor measured less than it appeared to. Repairing it requires re-posing the user-ratified C1 onto a period-agnostic orbit criterion, which is governance's call, not a queue-fill session's. Full measurement and successor recipe: REE_assembly evidence/planning/exq1007a_blocked_c1_satisfied_by_construction_20260908.md

The E3 channel-commensurability rung-3 readiness target -- '>= 2 E3 score channels simultaneously above a 1e-3 RELATIVE cross-candidate share in the 936 regime', pre-registered by the CONFIRMED failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-571c_2026-09-02 and restated as the acceptance condition in docs/architecture/sd_e3_channel_commensurability.md -- is an ARITHMETIC IDENTITY of the operator it is meant to validate, so no experiment adopting it can fail. The operator divides each channel's per-candidate term by an EMA of THAT CHANNEL'S OWN cross-candidate SD; the DV is the cross-candidate variance partition over those same terms, and e3_selector.py's own comment states the decomposition stores 'EFFECTIVE (post-commensurability) terms'. Var(term/s)=Var(term)/s^2 ~= 1 per channel, so shares go to 1/k and every channel above the 1e-12 absolute floor clears the 1e-3 relative floor (a 1000x tolerance). The spec's own build-time ON measurement, top_share 0.500000 with n_live 2, is exactly 1/2 -- the identity's fingerprint, not an effect. SEPARATELY, the natural control gate is refuted by 571c's landed manifest: its starved arm measured n_live 1/2/1/3 across seeds 42/43/45/46, and n_live==1 holds in only 7 of its 16 cells, so 'the monopoly means n_live==1' is a misreading of a worst-cell gate verdict. The owed validation V3-EXQ-1012 was authored, smoke-green, and NOT QUEUED. RECOMMEND the rung-3 target be re-posed onto a SELECTION-level DV (commit-flip under shadow OFF/ON scoring on the same tick and candidate set is the natural falsifier, and is what the spec's own argmin-invariance argument is actually about) before any validation is queued, and that the autopsy line and the SD doc be amended together since the sentence appears in both. Until then the rung is IMPLEMENTED but UNVALIDATABLE AS SPECIFIED, which differs materially from 'validation owed'. MECH-439's direction does NOT change: nothing here says the operator does or does not work, only that the target cannot tell. Full derivation, source citations and successor recipe: REE_assembly evidence/planning/exq1012_blocked_readiness_target_tautological_20260908.md
items.resolution_note: USER-APPROVED DECISION applied 2026-09-10 in REE_assembly c8116c399b (gov-flagbacklog-20260909; user read the docket and approved the recommendation). The tautology argument is mechanically sound and every citation checks out. The operator divides each channel's per-candidate term by an EMA of that channel's own cross-candidate SD, and the variance-partition DV is computed over those same post-division terms -- the code's own comment reads 'EFFECTIVE (post-commensurability) terms -- what actually entered the score'. The spec's build-time ON row is n_live 2 / top share 0.500000, exactly 1/k. The natural-control refutation also holds: 571c's env_starved_warmup arm measures n_live_channels 1/2/1/3 across seeds. DECISION AS APPLIED: THE DECISION. The rung-3 acceptance condition is an arithmetic property of the operator it is meant to validate: shares tend to 1/k and clear a 1e-3 floor by three orders of magnitude, so no experiment adopting it can fail. The owed validation V3-EXQ-1012 is authored and smoke-green but sits unqueued as a .blocked scratch file. Option A, RE-POSE THE TARGET onto a selection-level DV -- commit-flip rate under shadow OFF/ON scoring on the same tick and candidate set -- and amend the architecture doc and the autopsy's identical sentence TOGETHER. Cost: amending a CONFIRMED autopsy's pre-registered acceptance condition needs explicit governance authority and should be recorded as an amendment. Cost: spends a run to produce a foregone PASS and puts a spurious validation stamp into the record -- the alarm-fatigue vector. Option C, KEEP the target as a liveness gate and ADD a separate acceptance condition. Cost: two criteria to keep in sync; the weaker one will be cited. RECOMMEND A. Until done, the rung's honest status is IMPLEMENTED but UNVALIDATABLE AS SPECIFIED, materially different from 'validation owed'. Record: evidence/planning/governance_flag_adjudication_20260909.md. items.resolution_note: USER-APPROVED DECISION applied 2026-09-10 in REE_assembly c8116c399b (gov-flagbacklog-20260909; user read the docket and approved the recommendation). Confirmed: INV-105's title lists exactly seven distinctions (encoded/decodable/natively accessible/bridgeable/pairing-specific/causally used/behaviourally beneficial; docs/claims/claims.yaml:98096) and its notes call it a UNIVERSAL invariant that 'should not be given a falsification experiment' and that '/governance owns whether it is promoted to a gate' (:98111-98132). MECH-547's notes (:99150-99152) do assert the third binding consequence cited (a sender-only matched-capacity baseline and the permutation control as part of any receiver-conditioned bridge's evidence burden). DECISION AS APPLIED: Governance decision, as the claim itself frames it. (c) leave entirely as-is, no edit. RECOMMENDATION: (b) -- MECH-548 is a testable mechanism_hypothesis, not yet evidenced; INV-105 is explicitly definitional/non-experimental. Promoting MECH-548's specific framing into the invariant before it has any evidence risks having to revise a 'universal' claim later. OPTIONS: (a) Restate both titles/what_would_answer panels as an explicit bounded-tradeoff (floor on harm-sensitivity/interruptibility axis, competence allowed to trade against it only within that floor) -- costs a title/registration edit to two governance-level invariants and may require re-deriving falsifier panel acceptance bands; forecloses reading a future PASS as 'both maximized simultaneously'. (b) Leave the conjunctive form and record explicitly why it stands (e.g. REE's design intent is that the substrate should never need to trade, so any measured trade is itself a finding, not an expected operating point) -- costs nothing now but risks a future PASS/FAIL being misread against an unrealistic bar. RECOMMENDATION: option (a) -- both cited literature sources describe capacity-limited/exploration-limited trade surfaces from independent control mechanisms (attention, constrained RL), and REE's own falsifier panels for both claims already build in multi-axis, never-reduced-to-one-score measurement, so a Pareto-bound framing is a closer match to both the literature and REE's own existing test design than a conjunction-of-maxima framing. The partial correlation of w with z_harm_a given (u_h_n, u_p_n) is therefore identically zero, as the flag says, and the proposed re-run would return a guaranteed null. The refusal record exists at evidence/planning/gflag0080_mech235_harm_arbitration_design_refusal_20260909.md and its internal citations resolve. Record: evidence/planning/governance_flag_adjudication_20260909.md. RESIDUAL: DECISION FOR THE USER, stated cold. MECH-235 says the brain-like arbitration between deliberate planning and habit is continuous, and that unexpected threat pushes it toward habit. REE does have a continuous arbitration weight -- it was built in July and validated -- but it is driven by exactly two quantities: how unfamiliar the current situation is, and how badly the world model has been predicting. Harm plays no part in computing it. A previous governance note proposed settling the question cheaply by re-running an existing experiment while logging the harm signal; a design session on 2026-09-09 read the code and refused, because the weight is a deterministic function of those two inputs, so the answer is arithmetically fixed at zero before any run starts. That refusal is recorded and I have independently confirmed it from the source. THE DECISION IS WHAT TO DO WITH THE CLAIM NOW. OPTION A (the flag's own recommendation) -- keep MECH-235 as a candidate, mark its harm/urgency half as blocked on a substrate build, name the build, and close the older GFLAG-0080 against this record. COST: MECH-235 stays untested for as long as the build is unscheduled, and 'candidate' understates how well-specified the missing piece now is. FORECLOSES: nothing. OPTION B -- do the build now: add a harm-prediction-error term to the arbitrator behind a default-off switch (two concrete shapes are already written out, either about one line of substrate plus a config knob and a bit-identity contract), then run the experiment that becomes possible. COST: substrate work plus a cloud run; the predecessor run cost about 10.7 hours of compute. FORECLOSES: nothing, and it is the only route that can actually confirm or refute the claim. OPTION C -- narrow MECH-235 to what the substrate does support, i.e. arbitration on uncertainty rather than on urgency, and drop the harm leg. items.summary: ARC-053's assertion that ascending and descending signals must 'meet in the same phase channel' is under-specified against the anatomy, and this blocks a buildable P_i term. Bastos et al. 2015 (NeuroImage, DCM of macaque V1-V4, PMID 25585017, landed this session at evidence/literature/targeted_review_connectome_arc_053/) shows forward connections are carried predominantly by gamma and backward connections by alpha/beta -- i.e. the two directions occupy DIFFERENT frequency bands by default, so whatever the Temporal Coherence Loop does must be a CROSS-FREQUENCY alignment operation (plausibly phase-amplitude coupling, where descending beta phase gates the window admitting ascending gamma), not the alignment of two signals within one band. Recommended disposition: revise the claim's notes to commit to a cross-frequency formulation before any P_i implementation is attempted. This sharpens rather than contradicts the non-degeneracy precondition already recorded in ARC-053's what_would_answer field.

items.summary: ARC-054's notes present 'hippocampal rollout evaluation' as the claim's biological grounding, and the best-designed direct test of that framing comes out against it. Gillespie et al. 2021 (Neuron, PMID 34450026, landed this session at evidence/literature/targeted_review_arc_054/) used a dynamic task purpose-built to dissociate past experience from future choice -- the confound earlier replay-as-planning studies could not break -- and found replay content decoupled from the animal's subsequent choice, instead representing previously rewarded locations. Recommended disposition: revise the notes so the hippocampal-rollout framing is stated as contested rather than settled, and let ARC-054's V3 form carry the weight instead -- it already largely decouples from that substrate (reads MECH-269 per-region V_s walked by the MECH-288 segmenter, per v3_form_note), so V3-EXQ-491 is where the claim should stand or fall. This weakens the claim's GROUNDING, not its computational content: Champion et al. 2022 (PMID 35468491, same directory) independently establishes that horizon-discounted accumulation of a non-reward quantity over a tree of imagined futures is well-posed and tractable, and recovers reward-seeking as a special case -- the generalisation relation ARC-054 asserts.

items.summary: PIPELINE DEFECT (GOV-APPLY-1 ManifestResolver blind spot; the four v3_exq_259 claims are the concrete instance). check_unapplied_autopsy_recommendations.py's ManifestResolver.resolve() returns None for run_id v3_exq_259_wanting_gradient_navigation_1775666895, because that manifest exists ONLY at evidence/experiments/v3_exq_259_wanting_gradient_navigation/<run_id>.json -- inside its experiment-type subdirectory, with no top-level flat copy and no runs/<run_id>/manifest.json pack. The resolver looks only for the flat top-level path and packs. Consequence: _STRUCTURED_REC_CHECKS' recommended_evidence_direction check calls _direction_matches, which cannot see the manifest, returns False, and the four per-claim rows report as unapplied_disposition FOREVER regardless of what the manifest actually says. Verified this cycle: after setting evidence_direction_per_claim to superseded on all four (REE_assembly 676cc9ac62), matching the already-correct run-level superseded, GOV-APPLY-1 still reports all four. The audit's own header quantifies the population: 1208 targets carry a recommended_evidence_direction, of which only 1171 resolve -- so 37 targets are unresolvable this way, not just these. This is a DETECTOR blind spot, not owed governance work; the claim-layer applies are complete. Cross-reference GFLAG-0111, which already names V3-EXQ-259 among the flat-only manifests carrying real scored evidence. Fix direction is the resolver (teach it the experiment-type-subdirectory path), NOT relocating manifests.
items.resolution_note: FIXED in REE_assembly 2d5451429d (chip-20260909-govapply1-manifestresolver-blindspot). The flag's diagnosis was correct but named ONE of TWO coupled causes; neither fix clears the four v3_exq_259 rows alone. (1) RESOLVER, as flagged: ManifestResolver gained step 4 of an explicit precedence list -- a flat-only orphan matched by the run_id FIELD over the indexer's own globs (evidence/experiments/*.json then <experiment_type>/[!_]*.json, runs/ excluded, top-level first), consulted ONLY when the pack and both exact-path flat lookups miss, so it is strictly additive; dry-run smokes are skipped because resolving to one would certify against a manifest the indexer provably never scores. The 2026-08-20 exact-path rule for a PACK's flat sibling is untouched -- a field match is right in step 4 and wrong in steps 2-3, and the class docstring now says why. (2) PROSE ROUTING, not in the flag: _reflects sent the disposition prose '-> evidence_direction: superseded' to the claims.yaml named-field branch, which returns False on 'evidence_direction not in claim' -- true of EVERY claim, since evidence_direction is a manifest field and no claim carried the key. That spelling could never certify whatever the manifest said, and it is the spelling all four v3_exq_259 dispositions use. Both prose spellings now route to the manifest, gated on the same direction vocabulary as the bare form. Strictly additive: the branch was unconditionally False. RESULT: unapplied_disposition 5 -> 1 (all four of ARC-030/MECH-112/SD-012/SD-015 clear; the remaining row is ARC-037 from failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-1001_2026-09-04, unrelated and genuine). No claim-layer work was owed -- the 676cc9ac62 applies were already correct. POPULATION: of the flag's 37 unresolvable targets, exactly 2 were this shape (v3_exq_259, and v3_exq_472_sd011_platform_stability_pilot whose flat file is named ..._output.json and is reachable ONLY by the field match); the other 35 have no manifest on disk at all and are now REPORTED under their own named UNRESOLVED line with run_ids rather than folded into the coverage count, so this class cannot hide again. Resolving 472 added one new TRUE finding (its manifest carries no evidence_direction at all). ROOT CAUSE SHARED WITH GFLAG-0111, which STAYS OPEN: 0111 is flat-only manifests written via pack_writer.write_flat_manifest with no write_pack being invisible to scoring; the indexer grew _scan_flat_only_orphans on 2026-09-01 (76921a56ce) to close that, and this audit -- whose whole contract is to follow the indexer -- was not brought along, so 0243 is 0111's defect propagated one repo across. Both v3_exq_259 and v3_exq_472 are present in claim_evidence.v1.json, i.e. the indexer was already scoring them while this audit could not see them. 0111's remaining half is a scoring-semantics choice for /governance, not a code defect. TESTS: 21 new (88 total, all pass), each mutation-checked -- reverting step 4, the prose routing, the dry-run skip, or the UNRESOLVED counter independently reds the suite. --strict / --strict-direction exit contracts unchanged and pinned.

items.summary: FIFTH instance of the GFLAG-0117/0120 dry-run filter blind spot (read GFLAG-0117 first). evidence/experiments/_dry_v3_exq_918a_sd_residue_valence_bound_validation_20260909T062139Z_v3.json is _dry_-PREFIXED (the earlier four instances were _dry-SUFFIXED), has NO top-level dry_run field at all, and carries an ASSERTING stamp: evidence_direction 'supports', outcome PASS, experiment_purpose diagnostic. Because the field is unset, generate_pending_review.load_dry_run_run_ids() does not exclude it and it surfaced in this cycle's pending_review.md as an 'Unclaimed manifest (PASS/FAIL with no claim tags)' inviting a mark-discussed. It is claim-free (claim_ids: []) so nothing is currently weighted, and GOV-DRY-1 Step 3i reported 0 actionable for the same reason -- its asserting-stamp sweep also keys on the unset field. That is the point: the two independent nets that exist for this both miss it by the same mechanism. The prefix variant is new evidence that a filename heuristic is not the fix; the fix is making the driver/stamper emit top-level dry_run: true. Landed 2026-09-09T06:21Z, so a live producer is still emitting the shape.
items.resolution_note: PRODUCER FIXED at the writer: ree-v3 5181e49613 (2026-09-09) makes pack_writer.write_flat_manifest set top-level dry_run: true whenever it applies the _dry_ filename marker, mirroring the write_pack block that got this on 2026-07-28 and left the flat path behind. Root cause was NOT two conventions but one writer gap surfacing through two: V3-EXQ-918a (_dry_-PREFIXED, this writer's marker) and the still-live V3-EXQ-324d (_dry-SUFFIXED, baked into run_id at the driver) BOTH thread dry_run=True into that call and neither set the field itself, so one fix covers both. Confirms the flag's own reading that a consumer-side filename heuristic is the wrong fix -- reinforced by 78 manifests carrying dry_run:true with no filename marker at all. Guarded to never clobber an explicit caller value (V3-EXQ-365/608/632 set it themselves) and never add the key on a real run. Deliberately NOT a manifest_core ALWAYS_CORE/MANDATORY_CORE key: both assert PRESENCE on every manifest and dry_run must be ABSENT on a real run; unlike the 2026-09-09 flat-scalar-readout check (advisory because the corpus gap was too large) dry_run IS always computable at the writer.
